name: Kaitlyn in Chinaland
source:
The First Otome Chinese Learning Game!

When the self-consumed, all-American prom queen wannabe Kaitlyn gets sent to China as a punishment, she must navigate the waters of the language, the culture shocks... and the boys.

It's a West meets East romantic comedy about some of the pitfalls of living in China and struggling to belong.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=29286]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
第一款乙女向中文学习游戏！

自我中心、梦想成为全美舞会皇后的凯特琳被当作惩罚送到中国后，必须在语言障碍、文化冲击……以及男孩们之间周旋。

这是一部东西方相遇的浪漫喜剧，讲述在中国生活、努力融入当地时会遇到的各种陷阱。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=29286]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
